segments.text: Did we leave bags? I don't know, wait, how do we take it if we have bags on us?
You know why? Let's leave it.
I had probably nothing anyways. That's just my gym bag, guys.
It's got, like, dirty socks in it.
It's really nothing to go back for, guys. It really isn't.
It really isn't, guys. It truly isn't.
